issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5.3 Developer's Guide §3.4.1 System-Defined Types and §3.4 Type Testing
issues.evidence: `5 is Any` translates to `json_extract_string(5, '$.resourceType') = 'Any'` and fails in DuckDB with a binder error. Spec says System.Any is the maximal supertype and all values derive from it, so non-null primitive values must satisfy `is Any`.
issues.root_cause: CQL `is Any` was not handled as the maximal System.Any supertype; the translator fell through to FHIR resource JSON type matching and attempted `json_extract_string` on primitive SQL literals.
issues.resolution: Translate `is Any` to a non-null test, preserving CQL type-system semantics for all non-null values.
issues.verified_in: CQL-01 focused probe; primitive parity pytest; CQL official type/literal subset; CQL DuckDB conversion/type parity subset

issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5.3 Developer's Guide §3.1.3 Literals and §3.4.1 System-Defined Types
issues.evidence: `-2147483648` is rejected because the positive literal operand is range-checked before unary minus; `9223372036854775808L` and `-9223372036854775809L` translate successfully even though Long range is -2^63..2^63-1.
issues.root_cause: Primitive numeric literal range validation ran on the positive operand before unary negation, rejecting signed Integer minimum, while Long literals had no range guard.
issues.resolution: Added signed-minimum-aware unary negation handling for Integer/Long, positive Long range validation, exact Integer/Long type-test handling, and raw SQL rendering for high-precision Decimal literals.
issues.verified_in: CQL-01 focused probe; primitive parity pytest; CQL official type/literal subset; parser/expression/operator unit subset

issues.evidence: Public DuckDB surface returns `ToInteger('1.5') = 2` and `ToInteger('1.0') = 1`; direct Python `ConvertsToInteger('1.0')` is true. Spec string format for Integer/Long conversion is `(+|-)?#0`, so non-integer strings must return null/false.
issues.root_cause: DuckDB `ToInteger` macro delegated to `CAST`, which rounded decimal-looking strings and raised on out-of-range strings; direct Python Integer/Long conversion checks accepted integral Decimal string forms instead of the spec's integer string format.
issues.resolution: Replaced `ToInteger` with a regex-gated null-returning macro and tightened direct Python `ConvertsToInteger`, `ConvertsToLong`, and `ToLong` to the CQL integer-string grammar and Boolean overloads.
issues.verified_in: CQL-01 focused probe; primitive parity pytest; CQL DuckDB conversion parity subset; native CQL extension SQL test
